mapper.select: SELECT w.id, w.couple_id, w.user_id, w.title, w.description, w.is_done, w.done_date, w.created_at, u.nickname AS author FROM wish w LEFT JOIN user u ON w.user_id = u.id WHERE w.couple_id = #{coupleId} ORDER BY w.is_done ASC, w.created_at DESC
SELECT w.id, w.couple_id, w.user_id, w.title, w.description, w.is_done, w.done_date, w.created_at, u.nickname AS author FROM wish w LEFT JOIN user u ON w.user_id = u.id WHERE w.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wish (couple_id, user_id, title, description, is_done) VALUES (#{coupleId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{description}, 0)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM wish WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
